Body.Content:
Starting on November 30, 2026, AI-generated descriptions for model driven apps will have reached end of support.

How does this affect me?
The Create descriptions using AI option will no longer be available in the Publish dialog or the app designer Settings panel. Existing descriptions aren't affected, and you can continue to add or edit descriptions manually. For an AI-assisted option, the model app-builder skill outside Power Apps is available.

What action do I need to take?
This message is for awareness, and no action is required.

message.Title: Power Apps - Information regarding the end of support for AI-generated descriptions for model driven apps
